messages.speaker: Nia
messages.content: The blue samples failed only after the third rinse.

messages.speaker: Orin
messages.content: The pattern is clear: the third rinse causes the failures.

messages.speaker: Nia
messages.content: I found correlation at that point. I did not establish cause.

messages.speaker: Orin
messages.content: Agreed. That was your observation, and I promoted it into my causal conclusion.

messages.speaker: Nia
messages.content: Good. Retain my observation and mark causality unresolved.
